title: palettecore: derive, optimise and audit a scientific colour palette from one seed colour
description: Generates sequential, diverging and categorical colour palettes from a single seed colour in OKLCH with CIEDE2000 spacing, and audits every palette under simulated colour-vision deficiency (Machado et al. 2009 matrices, severity 1.0), greyscale conversion, sRGB gamut and WCAG contrast. Python reference implementation and R package validated against shared parity fixtures. Thresholds are configurable design rules, not established accessibility cut-offs.
